normalization.method: Connected-alpha whole-pose segmentation; one body calibration, nearest-neighbor pixel scale and render factor per native source. Explicit real corrective rows inserted without synthesizing anatomy.
normalization.baselineDefinition: bottom-exclusive full-pose alpha bound; ledge attachment uses separately measured real native palms.
normalization.alphaCleanup: Exclude near-transparent background noise below24; original PNGs archived unchanged.

sourceStatureCalibration.reason: Manually inspected complete upright crown-to-boot-sole interval. Bare hands are lowered and ranger longsword sheathed; no raised hand, blade, scabbard or VFX determines stature. A single source-wide scale preserves crouched, hanging, prone and aerial proportions.

visualValidation.facing: Right by default apart from genuine KO/airborne anatomical projection.
visualValidation.outfit: Adult Strider from Fellowship2001 before Amon Hen: shoulder-length dark brown hair, short beard, weathered brown leather ranger coat, dark gray-green cloak, dark trousers and leather boots.
visualValidation.weapons: Conventional ranger longsword and attached dark scabbard; sheathed on locomotion and all ledge contacts with visible free bare hands. Physical cuts and forearm guards, no Anduril, Army of the Dead, magic or projectile.
visualValidation.stature: 190px effective body calibration per native source; crouches, hanging arms and lowered projections keep their native proportions. Corrective source uses its own documented upright calibration.
limitations: Original generated gameplay adaptation, not official film animation or certified source1:1.
Opposite facing is the runtime horizontal mirror, including costume/scabbard asymmetry.
Shared platform-fighter charge, physical guard, kicks and aerial movement are explicit gameplay adaptations.
